svg.text: T-Display S3 → PIC18(L)F K22, HV ICSP
3.3 V targets only. The jig powers VDD from its 3V3 pin and switches MCLR between GND and 9 V with Q1 and Q2/Q3.
VPP on MCLR: 7.8–9.0 V at VDD 3.3 V
(VDD+4.5 V min; boost set to 8.5 V)
check at bring-up: unloaded and VPP on
MCLR net: Q3 drain, R2 → ICSP 1
R4 is required: GPIO10 floats at ESP32 boot.
MCLR floats ~5 µs on HV entry (break-before-make).
Target MCLR must tolerate 9 V: no reset button or
supervisor directly on it (isolate with a Schottky).
3.3 V targets only; ESP32 pins are not 5 V tolerant.
